title: astragalus nevadensis
intro: Astragalus nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to the western United States. It is a member of the pea family and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Astragalus nevadensis include its potential to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, that can help to modulate immune responses and protect against oxidative stress.
